text:
- Use named arm (right if specified; else left); locate target by description and displaystand by visual description (black open-frame, angled/smooth) before placing; pass xy=stand centre.
- Grasp target top-down at body centre; do not move stand/other objects.
- If place cannot see stand, locate it with description, then place at xy centre.
- If OFF_TARGET, home, relocate object with description; if not visible, move arm to view, re-grasp, place again.
- After release, home arm, open gripper; done only after checks on(object,stand) and released(arm) pass.
goal: Target object rests on displaystand top near centre, arm home, gripper open, object released.
